placements.why: The content describes a ratified architectural contract for async job dispatch — return semantics, polling model, and failure guarantees — which is architectural content requiring an Architecture strata category to organize it.
placements.title: System architecture decisions and contracts
placements.theme: Architectural contracts and design decisions govern how system components interact and what behavior they guarantee.

placements.title: Immediate-return dispatch replaces blocking extraction
placements.theme: The remember operation dispatches asynchronously, returning a receipt in seconds while extraction proceeds under a polling cursor, so no call blocks and no work is lost if the client drops the receipt.
placements.why: All three expressions cohere under the async job contract theme: src-1 declares the ratified contract (receipt in seconds, polling cursor), src-2 asserts non-blocking and lost-work-prevention properties, and src-3 restates the key decision (dispatch then poll or piggyback). No existing leaf holds this theme.
